simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יַעְרָה (H3294) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יַעְרָה (Yaʻrâh) means Jarah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 9 42.

definitions.full: H3294. Yarah II. יַעְרָה proper name, masculine a descendant of Saul 1Chr 9:42 (twice in verse), probably corrupt, see יְהוֺעַדָּה above
